items.title: Bot Description
items.text:
The Athena bot is a Discord bot focused on the Clash Of Clans game. Its goal is to help clan managers organize better and have statistics on team performance.

It notably allows for tracking wars via Google Sheets with advanced statistics and to manage clan war leagues via Google Sheets.

Development Information

A version 3 is currently in development. This new version will allow for an Esport module. This module will consist of:

  • Management via a shared Google calendar on Discord
  • Management of a competition environment on Discord
  • Tracking of matches played by the team
  • Improvement of player statistics

Info

The project is still in development.

Project team:

  • Poseidon COC

items.title: 🔐 Privacy Policy - Athena Bot
items.text:
Last updated: 2025-05-18

This privacy policy explains how Athena, the Discord bot dedicated to Clash of Clans, collects, uses, and protects user data.

items.title: 1. 📥 Data Collected
items.text: Athena collects only the data necessary for its proper functioning:

items.title: Discord Data:
items.text:
• Server identifiers (guild_id)
  • User identifiers (user_id) in certain commands (e.g.: role assignment)

items.title: Clash of Clans Data:
items.text:
• Clan and player tags
  • Public war information: attacks, performances, TH levels, etc.

items.title: Other Data:
items.text:
• Internal configuration (channels, roles, automated messages)
  • Google Sheets data if integration is used

✅ No sensitive data (passwords, IP addresses, private messages, etc.) is collected.

items.title: 2. 📦 Data Usage
items.text:
Data is used only for:

  • Tracking clan activity in wars
  • Generating automatic statistics and reports
  • Assigning roles based on configuration
  • Personalizing user experience

No data is sold, shared, or exposed to external third parties.

items.title: 3. 🗃️ Data Storage
items.text:
Data is stored on secure servers managed by the bot developers. Only authorized persons have access to this information.

Data is retained only for the duration necessary for its functional use.

items.title: 4. ❌ Data Deletion
items.text:
You can at any time request:

  • Deletion of data related to your server
  • Deletion of your Discord user information
  • Deletion of your Clash of Clans data (player tag, clan)

✉️ For this, contact an administrator via the bot's support server.

items.title: 5. 🧱 Security
items.text:
Measures are in place to protect data:

  • Restricted access to databases
  • Error logging without storing sensitive information
  • User input verification to prevent abuse

items.title: 6. 📑 Modifications
items.text: This policy may be modified at any time. Users will be informed via the official Discord server or via a dedicated bot command.

items.title: 7. 📬 Contact
items.text:
For any questions, requests, or complaints related to privacy, please contact the Athena bot team via:

  • The official Discord server
  • The bot developer

Thank you for trusting Athena, your Clash of Clans war assistant. 🛡️

items.title: 📜 Terms of Service - Athena Bot
items.text:
Last updated: 2025-05-18

Welcome and thank you for using Athena, a Discord bot designed to assist clans in managing and tracking Clash of Clans wars. By using this bot, you agree to the following terms.

items.title: 1. 📌 Acceptance of Terms
items.text: By adding or using Athena on your Discord server, you fully and unconditionally accept these terms of use. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the bot.

items.title: 2. ⚙️ Bot Features
items.text:
Athena offers the following services in particular:

  • Automatic tracking of wars (CWL, classic war).
  • Recording and analysis of attacks.
  • Role management based on clans.
  • Integration with Google Sheets.
  • Custom notifications and reports.

items.title: 3. 🔒 Data Collection
items.text:
The bot may store certain information, such as:

  • Discord identifiers (server, user) only within the framework of its features.
  • Clan tags, war results, and public attacks.
  • Clash of Clans account names and levels.

✅ No sensitive or private data is collected without your knowledge.

items.title: 4. 🛑 Prohibited Use
items.text:
You agree not to use Athena for:

  • Collecting or exploiting data for malicious or commercial purposes.
  • Disrupting the bot's operation (spam, API abuse, exploit attempts).
  • Broadcasting hateful, discriminatory, or illegal content through the bot's features.

items.title: 5. ❗ Availability and Responsibilities
items.text:
• The service may be temporarily interrupted for maintenance, updates, or unavailability of external APIs.
  • Athena is provided "as is", without warranty of accuracy or continuity.
  • The bot team cannot be held responsible for data loss or malfunctions.

items.title: 6. 📝 Modifications of Terms
items.text: These terms may be updated at any time without notice. It is your responsibility to check this page regularly.

items.title: 7. 📫 Contact
items.text:
For any questions or issues, you can contact the team via the bot's official Discord server or directly via a bot administrator.

Thank you for using Athena, and good luck in your wars! ⚔️

items.title: Description
items.text:
Allows configuring the server's e-sport environment. You can define the following:

  • The types of channels to create for competitions
  • Reminders before competitions
  • Automatic creation of the e-sport role
  • The channel where results will be published

items.title: Command structure
items.text: Command call: /esport-config-env

items.title: Configuration steps
items.text:
1. Channel selection Displays a menu to choose the types of channels to create for each competition:
  2. <competition>-Vocal
  3. <competition>-Information
  4. <competition>-Results

  5. <competition>-Flood

  6. Reminder selection Displays a menu to choose the desired reminders before the competition:

  7. 3h
  8. 2h
  9. 1h
  10. 45 min
  11. 30 min
  12. 20 min

  13. 10 min

  14. E-sport role Option to automatically create an e-sport role via a boolean choice (Yes / No).

  15. Results channel Selection of the channel where competition results will be published.

items.title: User return
items.text:
After validation, the bot sends a summary message:

✅ Configuration saved successfully!

Configured channels: Vocal, Information, Flood
Reminders: 10 min, 20 min, 30 min, 45 min, 1h
E-sport role creation: Yes
Results channel: <#1437813880855199806>

items.title: Moderation Commands
items.text:
Here is the list of available moderation commands.

  • Banning a User
  • Kicking a User
  • Revoking a Ban

items.title: Permissions
items.text:
To use this command, you must have at minimum the following permissions:

Permissions

  • Administrator
  • Ban members

items.title: Description
items.text: Allows you to ban a member from the server.

items.title: Command Structure
items.text:
Command call: /ban

Parameter(s):

  • user: User to ban (required)
  • reason: Reason for the ban (optional)

items.title: User Return
items.text: Confirms the ban or indicates an error.

items.title: Permissions
items.text:
To use this command, you must have at minimum the following permissions:

Permissions

  • Administrator
  • Kick members

items.title: Description
items.text: Allows you to kick a member from the server.

items.title: Command Structure
items.text:
Command call: /kick

Parameter(s):

  • user: User to kick (required)
  • reason: Reason for the kick (optional)

items.title: User Return
items.text: Confirms the kick or indicates an error.

items.title: Permissions
items.text:
To use this command, you must have at minimum the following permissions:

Permissions

  • Administrator
  • Ban members

items.title: Description
items.text: Allows you to revoke a ban on a user.

items.title: Command Structure
items.text:
Command call: /unban

Parameter(s):

  • user: User ID to unban (required)

items.title: User Return
items.text: Confirms the unban or indicates an error.
